claims.technical_wording: The frozen task produces a 24-hour-ahead load forecast that is consumed by a battery peak-shaving dispatch evaluation; forecasting is an input to the decision task, not the terminal objective.
claims.presentation_wording: 预测不是终点：24 小时前瞻负荷预测服务于电池削峰决策。
claims.caveat: The evidence supports peak-demand reduction only, not tariff savings, carbon reduction, or energy-use reduction.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: The system has validated electricity-cost savings, carbon reduction, or lower energy consumption.

claims.technical_wording: On the frozen 8-building Test aggregate, XGBoost has slightly lower normalized RMSE than LightGBM (0.216751 versus 0.216942) but higher normalized decision regret (0.117534 versus 0.116127).
claims.presentation_wording: 更低的预测 RMSE 不必然带来更好的储能决策：冻结 Test 结果中，XGBoost 的 RMSE 略优，决策 regret 却更差。
claims.caveat: The RMSE gap is small and this is a project-specific counterexample, not proof that forecast accuracy never matters.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Forecast accuracy is irrelevant, or all more accurate models make worse decisions.

claims.technical_wording: Phase 8 evaluates 11 predeclared DayWeek/LightGBM weights on Validation and freezes each building's weight by mean daily regret versus a non-deployable Oracle; for Hog_office_Joey, forecast-MAE selection chooses w=0.6 while decision-regret selection chooses w=0.3.
claims.presentation_wording: DOEF 不只按预测误差选融合权重，而是在 Validation 上按储能决策 regret 冻结权重。
claims.caveat: The Joey weights are an illustrative frozen example; Oracle is hindsight-only and non-deployable.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Weights were tuned on Test, or the Oracle is deployable.

claims.technical_wording: The benchmark fixes 8 heterogeneous office buildings using Train-only morphology after frozen eligibility filtering from 296 office candidates, of which 82 pass the frozen quality rules.
claims.presentation_wording: 在 296 个办公候选中按冻结质量规则筛到 82 个，再仅用 Train 期形态预选 8 栋异质办公建筑。
claims.split: Train-only building selection; later Validation/Test evaluation
claims.caveat: This is multi-building evaluation across fixed buildings, not unseen-building transfer.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: DOEF generalizes to unseen buildings, zero-shot transfers, or performs domain adaptation.

claims.technical_wording: DOEF v1.0 is formally named Decision-Oriented Ensemble Forecasting and computes w_b·LightGBM + (1-w_b)·DayWeek for a 24-hour-ahead forecast, with w_b frozen per building by Validation decision regret before battery dispatch evaluation.
claims.presentation_wording: DOEF v1.0（Decision-Oriented Ensemble Forecasting）把因果预测、决策导向融合和电池削峰评估连成一条冻结流程。
claims.caveat: The pipeline is integrated for evaluation; it is not end-to-end differentiable training and does not claim online deployment.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: DOEF is a new LightGBM model, an end-to-end differentiable optimizer, or a deployed production system.

claims.technical_wording: On the frozen 8-building Test aggregate, DOEF reduces mean normalized MAE from 0.147338 for LightGBM to 0.137970, a relative improvement of 6.3585%.
claims.presentation_wording: 在冻结的 8 栋建筑 Test 汇总上，DOEF 相对 LightGBM 的 normalized MAE 改善 6.36%。
claims.aggregation: equal-building mean; normalized by frozen Train mean load
claims.caveat: One fixed Test month per building; the result is not evidence of universal or unseen-building performance.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: DOEF beats all forecasting methods everywhere or is state of the art.

claims.technical_wording: On the frozen 8-building Test aggregate, DOEF reduces mean normalized decision regret from 0.116127 for LightGBM to 0.111929, a relative improvement of 3.6147%, with 6 building wins, 2 ties, and 0 losses.
claims.presentation_wording: DOEF 相对 LightGBM 的 normalized decision regret 改善 3.61%，建筑级结果为 6 胜、2 平、0 负。
claims.caveat: Regret is defined against the non-deployable Oracle under the frozen battery protocol; this is not monetary regret.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: DOEF beats every method on every building, or the improvement is monetary savings.

claims.technical_wording: Across the 8 fixed Test buildings, DOEF's mean whole-window peak reduction is 6.4423%; the building-level minimum is -1.0170%, so the frozen evidence includes a degradation case.
claims.presentation_wording: DOEF 的 8 栋建筑平均削峰率为 6.44%，同时如实保留最差建筑 -1.02% 的负结果。
claims.aggregation: equal-building mean and building minimum of whole-window peak reduction
claims.caveat: Whole-window peak reduction is not daily-average peak reduction; one building is negative.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: DOEF always reduces peak demand, or every building improves.

claims.technical_wording: The frozen Phase 3 selection table represents 1,578 building series; 296 are office candidates.
claims.presentation_wording: 项目冻结的 BDG2 选择表覆盖 1,578 栋建筑序列，其中 296 栋为办公候选。
claims.caveat: The 1,578 count is scoped to this repository's frozen selection table.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: BDG2 universally has exactly 1,578 buildings.

claims.technical_wording: Forecasts use only causally available load-history and calendar features for a 24-hour horizon; target leakage and weather features are excluded in the frozen protocol.
claims.presentation_wording: 24 小时前瞻预测只使用因果可得的负荷历史与日历特征。
claims.caveat: This does not claim the feature set is optimal or exhaustive.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: The system uses real-time future weather or future target values.

claims.technical_wording: All model and ensemble choices were frozen using Validation only; Test is evaluation-only and cannot promote an algorithm.
claims.presentation_wording: 所有模型与融合选择均只用 Validation 冻结，Test 仅用于评估。
claims.model_scope: all selected models and ensemble weights
claims.caveat: Historical Test results had been viewed; the safe statement concerns non-use for selection, not pristine visibility.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: The Test set was pristine, completely untouched, or never viewed.

claims.technical_wording: A frozen building-level paired bootstrap of DOEF minus LightGBM normalized mean decision regret uses 10,000 resamples and yields point estimate -0.004198 with 95% interval [-0.006850, -0.001719].
claims.presentation_wording: 以建筑为重采样单位的冻结 bootstrap 区间仍位于 0 以下。
claims.caveat: Only 8 building units are available; the bootstrap quantifies uncertainty within this fixed scope.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: This proves universal statistical superiority across buildings.

claims.technical_wording: The explicit DOEF v1.0 formula reproduces all 5,760 frozen Phase 8 ensemble predictions with maximum absolute difference 0.0 kW.
claims.presentation_wording: DOEF v1.0 公式对 5,760 个冻结预测实现零差异复现。
claims.caveat: This is prediction identity, not a fresh model rerun or independent replication.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: A new independent experiment reproduced the result.

claims.technical_wording: Forecast-driven daily battery schedules are evaluated on realized load under frozen capacity, power, efficiency, SOC, and daily-reset constraints.
claims.presentation_wording: 所有预测方法在同一冻结电池约束下比较，实现从预测到真实削峰结果的闭环评价。
claims.caveat: The protocol is a fixed offline evaluation, not a field deployment.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: The battery controller has been deployed in real buildings.

claims.technical_wording: Peak-reduction conclusions must retain method, building, split, whole-window/daily scope, and aggregation labels; CatBoost's frozen Test mean is -24.4824% while its median is 4.8209%.
claims.presentation_wording: 削峰率必须同时说明方法、建筑范围和聚合口径；均值与中位数可能给出相反印象。
claims.caveat: The extreme mean is driven by a documented low-load building case; do not collapse it to one unlabeled scalar.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Peak reduction is one universal scalar or CatBoost uniformly increases peaks.

claims.technical_wording: Negative or mixed frozen outcomes are retained and are not used to revise the Validation-frozen algorithm after Test evaluation.
claims.presentation_wording: 负结果不被隐藏，也不用于 Test 后反向改选算法。
claims.caveat: These experiments are supporting falsification evidence, not DOEF components.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Every attempted method improved Test performance.

claims.technical_wording: For Hog_office_Rolando Test, the Validation-selected robust LightGBM configuration (lambda=0.5) has mean regret 20.4635 kW versus 11.1274 kW for deterministic LightGBM.
claims.presentation_wording: 稳健优化实验是负结果：Test mean regret 由 11.1274 kW 恶化至 20.4635 kW。
claims.caveat: Single-building negative supporting experiment; not part of DOEF v1.0.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Robust optimization improved Test performance.

claims.technical_wording: Raw meter observations are kWh per one-hour interval; dispatch quantities are interpreted as interval-average kW, while battery capacity and SOC remain kWh.
claims.presentation_wording: 一小时时间步下，负荷读数按区间能量解释，调度功率用 kW，电池容量与 SOC 用 kWh。
claims.caveat: Numerical values coincide only because delta-t equals one hour.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: kWh and kW are interchangeable units.

claims.technical_wording: The frozen evaluation contains one fixed future Test month per building; Test did not select models or weights but historical Test results had been viewed.
claims.presentation_wording: Test 不参与选择，但评估范围仅为每栋建筑一个固定未来月份，且不能称为从未查看。
claims.split: one fixed Test month per building
claims.caveat: This limits temporal generalization and pristine-Test wording.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Completely untouched pristine Test set or broad temporal generalization.

claims.technical_wording: DOEF uses frozen per-building Validation-selected weights rather than one universal ensemble weight; the Joey decision-selected LightGBM weight is 0.3.
claims.presentation_wording: DOEF 使用逐建筑冻结权重，而不是一个全局固定权重。
claims.caveat: Do not generalize Joey's value to other buildings.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: DOEF always uses w=0.3.

claims.technical_wording: The Phase 9.1 invariance audit confirms the reporting definition is byte-identical in values to the frozen Phase 8 ensemble prediction over 5,760 samples.
claims.presentation_wording: 报告中的 DOEF 定义与冻结 Phase 8 预测逐值一致。
claims.caveat: This does not repair the separately documented historical canonical-loader parent-hash caveat.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: All repository lineage issues are repaired.
